**Finding: deviation (medium)** — § 14.3 Choice of Law.

- **Governing law:** New York — matches our preferred position, no change needed.
- **Forum:** absent. There is no venue, jurisdiction, or arbitration provision anywhere in the Agreement (§ 14.4 is only a jury-trial waiver; § 14.14 only a two-year limitations period). No foreign arbitration seat, so no walk-away trigger.
- **Redline (validated, preferred level):** appended exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County to the existing sentence, leaving the choice-of-law wording intact; Delaware/California/London courts flagged as acceptable fallback in the comment.
